focus: mimo-03: The goal hook and compaction, friction and proof

label: verifyGoalHeuristic is a regex and keyword ladder with a fixed 0.72 met confidence, evidence under 24 chars staying unclear, and its result shape already carries source: heuristic so a shadow verifier needs no schema change

The operator never reads the goal verdict; its errors surface as model behavior via the observe-only nudge on non-met and the last_check line in the injected block, so the measurable UX outcome is repeated work and goal drift
The smallest goal-verifier gold set is 30 to 50 operator-labeled turn excerpts across met, not-met and unclear, scored for both the heuristic and a Jev arm; no such set exists today
The precompact tests cover payload caching, overwrite and token budget but nothing about what survives a compaction, so fact-recall measurement needs a new transcript-plus-must-survive-facts harness

A Jev keep-or-drop compaction pass is precomputed-only at this repository's 1800 ms internal budget, ships off by default, and waits behind an unmeasured prompt-cache breakage risk and the cheaper move of enlarging the token budget
Synchronous in-hook Jev calls drop outright: the 60 s client timeout cannot fit the 3 s precompact hook, and any under-10 s seam needs a shadow, cached or async shape
